Endfield Model Importer 1.4.8 and XXMI Libraries 1.2.2
EFMI https://github.com/SpectrumQT/EFMI-Package/tree/v1.4.8
XXMI https://github.com/SpectrumQT/XXMI-Libs-Package/tree/v1.2.2

Runtime libraries and core files imported from the user's local EFMI installation.
EFMI and XXMI copyrights and GPL license texts are retained in this directory.
The upstream manifests record the installed versions and original signatures.

EAI configuration changes:
- The permitted loader name is EModLoader.Launcher.exe.
- The appearance include directory is ../../mod, relative to runtime/efmi.
- Game launch is handled by EAI instead of an INI-embedded executable path.
- The bundled startup guide uses EAI's mod-folder workflow.
- Community promotion links are removed from the guide and update/error prompts.
- d3d11.dll is rebuilt from XXMI 1.2.2. It refreshes fixed-size mesh buffers,
  accepts transient position updates, and previews changes to loaded persistent
  INI variables on the rendering thread. The source changes are in
  patch_live_buffers.py and the build is scripted in .github/scripts/build_xxmi.py.

The EAI source archive includes upstream source tarballs in
third_party/appearance-sources and the local configuration/core snapshot here.
User appearance mods, persistent settings, logs and caches are supplied separately.
